desc: Implement a helper that computes optimal scores for all even-length prefixes of a sequence using a two-heap median-split structure (lower half as max-heap, upper half as min-heap, with running sums).
Compute prefix scores `pref[i]` for all even `i`, with `pref[0] = 0`.
Compute suffix scores `suff[i]` for all suffixes starting at index `i` with even length, with `suff[N] = 0`, by scanning right-to-left or reusing the prefix helper on the reversed array.
If `N` is even, output `pref[N]`; if `N` is odd, output the maximum of `pref[k] + suff[k + 1]` over all even `k` (0-based count of elements before the survivor).
Ensure the program reads from stdin and writes to stdout, uses 64-bit integer arithmetic, and handles duplicates, all-equal arrays, `N = 2`, and maximum input size efficiently.
